mapper.update: INSERT INTO sync_metadata ( tenant_id, entity_kind, source_service, scope_key, scope_key_hash, business_key, business_key_hash, sync_key, sync_key_hash, target_id, target_status, last_sync_occurred_at, last_sync_sequence_no, extra, created_at, updated_at, delete_flag ) VALUES ( #{record.tenantId}, #{record.entityKind}, #{record.sourceService}, #{record.scopeKey}, #{record.scopeKeyHash}, #{record.businessKey}, #{record.businessKeyHash}, #{record.syncKey}, #{record.syncKeyHash}, #{record.targetId}, #{record.targetStatus}, #{record.lastSyncOccurredAt}, #{record.lastSyncSequenceNo}, COALESCE(CAST(#{record.extra} AS jsonb), '{}'::jsonb), now(), now(), 0 ) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, entity_kind, source_service, scope_key_hash, business_key_hash) WHERE delete_flag = 0 DO UPDATE SET scope_key = EXCLUDED.scope_key, business_key = EXCLUDED.business_key, sync_key = EXCLUDED.sync_key, sync_key_hash = EXCLUDED.sync_key_hash, target_id = EXCLUDED.target_id, target_status = EXCLUDED.target_status, last_sync_occurred_at = EXCLUDED.last_sync_occurred_at, last_sync_sequence_no = EXCLUDED.last_sync_sequence_no, extra = EXCLUDED.extra, updated_at = now()

INSERT INTO sync_metadata ( tenant_id, entity_kind, source_service, scope_key, scope_key_hash, business_key, business_key_hash, sync_key, sync_key_hash, target_id, target_status, last_sync_occurred_at, last_sync_sequence_no, extra, created_at, updated_at, delete_flag ) VALUES ( #{metadata.tenantId}, #{metadata.entityKind}, #{metadata.sourceService}, #{metadata.scopeKey}, #{metadata.scopeKeyHash}, #{metadata.businessKey}, #{metadata.businessKeyHash}, #{metadata.syncKey}, #{metadata.syncKeyHash}, #{metadata.targetId}, #{metadata.targetStatus}, #{metadata.lastSyncOccurredAt}, #{metadata.lastSyncSequenceNo}, COALESCE(CAST(#{metadata.extra} AS jsonb), '{}'::jsonb), now(), now(), 0 ) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, entity_kind, source_service, scope_key_hash, business_key_hash) WHERE delete_flag = 0 DO UPDATE SET scope_key = EXCLUDED.scope_key, business_key = EXCLUDED.business_key, sync_key = EXCLUDED.sync_key, sync_key_hash = EXCLUDED.sync_key_hash, last_sync_occurred_at = EXCLUDED.last_sync_occurred_at, last_sync_sequence_no = EXCLUDED.last_sync_sequence_no, updated_at = now() WHERE EXCLUDED.last_sync_occurred_at > sync_metadata.last_sync_occurred_at OR (EXCLUDED.last_sync_occurred_at = sync_metadata.last_sync_occurred_at AND EXCLUDED.last_sync_sequence_no > sync_metadata.last_sync_sequence_no)
